platforms.name: Browser extension (Chromium)
platforms.notes: The packaged zip strips the development key; the Chrome Web Store ID will differ from the unpacked ID. 1.3.0 adds language-aware page-text scoring: each reviewed term carries a language, the page language is detected from its text rather than only its tag, and unknown languages fall back to the full list. Seed v5 still supplies the 239,885-domain core tier (480 static rules).

platforms.name: Mac
platforms.state: development · unsigned, needs Developer ID and notarization
platforms.notes: Every target must carry the same MARKETING_VERSION and CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION; 1.1.7 adds the read-only protection-authority layer (daily account, visible guardian admin, root daemon) and disables authority/removal controls while a lock runs. Unsigned/unnotarized.

platforms.name: iPhone & iPad
platforms.state: development · no Apple team, Family Controls entitlement or test device
platforms.notes: The app, six Safari blockers and HisnActivityMonitor share one version set; 1.1.4 raises Safari capacity from four to six 40,000-rule parts and bundles seed v5 (239,885 domains).

platforms.name: Android
platforms.state: preview · unsigned; direct builds add the -direct suffix
platforms.notes: versionCode is monotonic and must increase for every uploaded or side-loaded update. 25 adds the protection lock: saved rules are fully frozen while it runs, the direct build's removal guard arms itself from the lock, and the device-owner uninstall block is applied for the lock. Release APKs are checked unsigned; a production key is still required.
